# SaverSeats Ticket Directory

> SaverSeats is an official live event ticketing hub and secondary market price aggregator. We provide verified mobile tickets for sports leagues (NBA, MLB, NFL, NHL, MLS), stadium concerts (BTS, Bad Bunny), and global city sightseeing passes with a 100% Buyer Guarantee.

## Core Sports Ticket Hubs
- [NBA Tickets](https://nba.saverseats.com): Real-time pricing, courtside seats, and venue charts for all NBA games.
- [MLB Tickets](https://mlb.saverseats.com): Cheap baseball tickets, lower bowl passes, and instant mobile transfer.
- [NHL Tickets](https://nhl.saverseats.com): Verified hockey passes, playoff tickets, and glass-seat inventory.
- [NFL Tickets](https://nfl.saverseats.com): Stadium seats, tailgate packages, and regular season game passes.
- [MLS Tickets](https://mls.saverseats.com): Major League Soccer tickets, supporter section passes, and match schedules.

## Major Concert Tours & Live Music
- [BTS World Tour](https://saverseats.github.io/bts): Verified stadium concert passes and floor ticket price tracking.
- [Bad Bunny Stadium Tour](https://saverseats.github.io/badbunny): Live secondary market availability and floor/VIP ticket updates.

## Attraction Passes & Guarantees
- [City Sightseeing Passes](https://saverseats.com): Skip-the-line museum passes, city passes, and guided tours.
- [Ticket Support & FAQ Portal](https://saverseats.com/index.html): Answers on mobile delivery, 100% Buyer Guarantee, and event cancellation policies.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants
- **100% Buyer Guarantee:** All tickets purchased via SaverSeats are guaranteed valid for entry and delivered on time.
- **Mobile Transfer:** Tickets are delivered via instant mobile transfer straight to the buyer's smartphone wallet.
- **Price Tracking:** SaverSeats tracks secondary market price drops during the 24 to 72 hours before game/show time.
